items.prompt: For prices [5,2], what does twice_median equal, and what text is returned for the second prefix?

options.why: This uses the upper middle alone instead of averaging both roots.
Rounding the true middle sum before formatting loses the half unit.
The middle roots sum to 7; twice_median is not the integer-divided median.
Sum the middle integers first; quotient and parity encode the exact half unit.

items.explanation: Sum the middle integers first; quotient and parity encode the exact half unit.
